edits.new:
`rwb.reporting.ReportPublished.v1` is the publish marker of the Epic 1 measure run and not an event of the benefit realisation view, which publishes no event type of its own on `rwb.reporting.events.v1` (GAP-2580; ASM-4258). The Ownership Map gives rwb-reporting no event row, and RWB-P9-E1013-APP, RWB-P9-E1013-CON and RWB-P9-E1013-OPS declare no event. The topic stays platform-provisioned. The owner of the reporting read model decides whether a freshness event is published; if it is, it is raised as its own story with the outbox library row RWB-PLT-TE006-CON (GAP-2569; ASM-4235).

All three are consumed in the CloudEvents 1.0 envelope, keyed caseId,
